title: ARCADE: THE MODE ROW AND BOTH WINDOWS
why: His order of 2026-10-11, the 2 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO, build 5 of 20. The title has a new row, 2 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO, under the co-op row. It opens the player 2 window the way co-op does and puts both windows into the arcade: his save is set aside, the what is new card is skipped, and the arcade attract covers the screen. The player 1 window drops straight into an endless arcade raid on any key, click, touch or controller button (F1 to F12, Shift, Ctrl and Alt do not, and moving the mouse never does). The player 2 window says PLAYER 2: PRESS A and joins with A on its own controller (the join itself is the next build). A rebooted player 2 window is put back into the arcade, and leaving the arcade takes player 2 out too. Normal play and normal co-op are exactly as they were.
now: The title has a 2 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO row: any key or button drops you straight into an arcade raid.
